Team sync for OAuth in Grafana OSS

Add users to Grafana teams, and remove them, based on the groups your identity provider returns at login. Combine it with OAuth organization mapping to give every tenant its own organization and teams.

Features Quick start Keycloak demo Settings Troubleshooting Changelog

Features

  • Maps IdP groups to teams per organization with <group>:<org>:<team>.
  • Adds and removes external memberships on every login.
  • Keeps memberships that an administrator added manually.
  • Optionally creates missing teams.
  • Never blocks a login when a sync step fails.

Quick start

  1. Create one organization per tenant in Grafana.
  2. Map groups to organizations with org_mapping in your OAuth provider section.
  3. Turn on team sync and list the group to team mappings.
[auth.generic_oauth]
groups_attribute_path = groups
org_attribute_path = groups
org_mapping = tenant-a-users:TenantA:Editor tenant-b-users:TenantB:Viewer

[auth.team_sync]
enabled = true
auto_create_teams = false
mappings = tenant-a-ops:TenantA:Ops tenant-b-ops:TenantB:Ops

Run the tests in a container: docker compose -f tests/docker-compose.yml run --rm test

Try it with Keycloak

The repository includes a Keycloak with two demo tenants. make sso-deploy builds Grafana and starts both, wired together with org mapping and team sync. Open http://localhost:3000 and sign in with Keycloak. The password of every demo user is SSO_TEST_PASSWORD in .env.

UserOrganizations and rolesTeams
aliceTenantA: AdminTenantA: Ops
bobTenantA: EditorTenantA: Developers
carolTenantB: ViewerTenantB: Ops
daveTenantA: Editor, TenantB: ViewerTenantB: Ops
erinMain Org., TenantA, TenantB: AdminNone
frankMain Org.: ViewerNone

Run make sso-test to log in as each user through Keycloak and check the result. Stop everything with make sso-down.

Settings

SettingEnvironment variableDefaultDescription
enabledGF_AUTH_TEAM_SYNC_ENABLEDfalseTurns team sync on.
mappingsGF_AUTH_TEAM_SYNC_MAPPINGSemptySpace or comma separated <group>:<org name or id>:<team> list. Escape a colon with \:.
auto_create_teamsGF_AUTH_TEAM_SYNC_AUTO_CREATE_TEAMSfalseCreates a mapped team when it doesn't exist.

Troubleshooting

  • Nothing happens: check enabled = true and the log for invalid mapping errors.
  • User isn't added: the user must be a member of the organization. Check org_mapping first. Set [log] filters = team.sync:debug.
  • Team doesn't exist: create it or set auto_create_teams = true.
  • Organization can't be resolved: use the exact organization name or its numeric ID.

The full guide is docs/sources/setup-grafana/configure-access/configure-team-sync-oss.md.
